mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.id AS submission_id, s.assignment_id, s.version, a.period_label, u.display_name AS submitted_by_name, s.comment, a.title AS assignment_title, t.name AS template_name, c.name AS company_name, s.submitted_at FROM report_submissions s JOIN report_assignments a ON a.id = s.assignment_id JOIN report_templates t ON t.id = a.template_id JOIN companies c ON c.id = s.submitted_by_company_id JOIN users u ON u.id = s.submitted_by WHERE a.issuer_department_id = #{departmentId} AND s.status = 'pending_receipt' ORDER BY s.submitted_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO submission_receipts (submission_id, issuer_department_id, received_by, action, comment) VALUES (#{submissionId}, #{issuerDepartmentId}, #{receivedBy}, #{action}, #{comment})
